mirror.name: files
mirror.sql: CREATE TABLE files (path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL, mtime_ms REAL NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

mirror.name: meta
mirror.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (only INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (only = 1), cursor INTEGER NOT NULL)

text.var/lib/ta/generations/<engine>: a decimal integer, the engine store's generation
text.var/lib/ta/scratch-used/<agent>: an empty file, its modification time the agent's last use
text.var/lib/ta/format: a decimal integer and a newline, the newest format on the disk
